openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: The TD-W9980 is a VDSL-capable router launched in 2014. It's identical to the TD-W8980 ... Just the 5 GHz Wifi cannot be used and for VDSL you'll need to use a propriertary binary blob
openwrt_wiki.TD-W9980B: nearly identical, with the exception that you can't flash via the Web UI exploit. The B is for annex B and cannot be changed
Known Issues: Switch acts weird (forwarding broadcast frames to all ports) - ticket 14439/15511
Switch doesn't allow tagged and untagged traffic on the same port
Failsafe-Mode is not accessible via ethernet when triggered with the WPS button and indicated by led (fixed for TDW8970)
openwrt_wiki.Installation: Seems like the W8980 image can by sysupgraded without an issue; Wege: serielle Konsole (UART-Boot mit u-boot.asc, R225 gegen GND, dann TFTP) oder Web-Oberflächen-Konfigurationstrick (nur TD-W9980, nicht TD-W9980B)
openwrt_wiki.Gehäuse öffnen: remove the four screws, and then pry the case with a small flat screwdriver, starting from the top ... till the eight marked points of the case pop out; detach the U.FL RF connectors; copper pads on each side of the board which are glued to the plastic case while also being soldered onto the board

Serial.Bestückung: The pin header for the serial console is not populated. It has to be soldered onto the board. A usual 2.5mm J7 pin header will do the job.
Serial.Pins for TD-W9980B (from top to bottom): Rx, Tx, GND, VCC (3.3V) DO NOT CONNECT VCC!
Serial.Hinweis: Press t on the console to interrupt U-Boot autobooting. Logon through serial ... admin/1234
Serial.Pegel: use a logic converter to drop it down to the router's 3 Volt TX and RX pins
Serial.Boot-Auswahl: Left R225 pad, bottom of the board ... keep a left side of R225 shorted to UART GND (W9980 und W9980B; reportedly different for w8980)

openwrt_wiki.DSL: advertised to support at most ITU G.993.2; vectoring works with 5.7.6 firmware blob (Annex B Beispiel)
openwrt_wiki.Reset: the reset button resets the configuration; failsafe (WPS button on the back) doesn't make the device accessible
openwrt_wiki.Flash: EEPROM size is 8MiB; first 128KiB bootloader; last 256KiB not in any firmware download (radio/MAC)
